description: restart: restarts containers. redeploy: pulls the image again and recreates containers (hard=true also wipes data). remove: uninstalls from nodes; the registration stays and the network re-spawns it elsewhere, so use flux_cancel_app to stop paying. Scope is one node (nodeIp) or every node running the app (global). Requires the owner key.

fluxIdPrivateKey.description: WIF private key of the Flux ID that owns the app. Use a dedicated key from flux_generate_keys, never a main wallet key.

hard.description: For redeploy: also delete the app data.

nodeIp.description: Required for scope=node; also the node the global command is sent through.

paymentPrivateKey.description: WIF private key of the Flux address that pays. Fund it with only what you intend to spend.

name: flux_control_app
title: Restart, redeploy or remove app instances
